article.title: Modeling human embryo implantation in vitro

reported_scope.model_question: Reconstruct an early receptive endometrial interface to study human blastocyst implantation and early post-implantation development.
reported_scope.embryo_start_stage: surplus human blastocysts at 5–6 days post-fertilization
reported_scope.reported_embryo_endpoint: up to 14 days post-fertilization in the described UK/Spain experiments
reported_scope.whole_paper_count_qualification: The article gives 248 embryos used across the study; it is not a denominator for a single 14-day outcome or scRNA-seq comparison.
reported_scope.selection_and_exclusions: Only recovered blastocysts that had fully expanded were advanced to scaffolds. Embryos degenerating before the target stage were excluded; the count and endpoint-specific attrition are not reported in the reviewed source.
reported_scope.scRNA_site_count_qualification: The article reports 17 day-14 implantation sites processed for scRNA-seq. The public submission contains seven sample groups; the 17-to-7 site/sample mapping is not present in the submitted metadata.

metadata_only_fastq_head_probe.interpretation: Availability/declared file size only; not content or checksum validation.

ena_read_run_report.qualification: The report exposes run metadata but its file fields are blank. SDRF-listed paths are separately HEAD-checked; do not infer files are absent from the ENA report fields alone.

sample_intake.independent_unit_qualification: The assay submission contains seven source sample groups and combined source labels; individual implantation sites, embryos, cell counts, sequencing runs and FASTQ files must not be treated as interchangeable independent units. The 17-site-to-seven-group mapping and a validated per-embryo outcome table are unavailable.

observation_intake.reason_not_promoted: This cycle verified source and data routing and built the unit crosswalk, but did not analyze the processed RDS matrices or transcribe source-located per-embryo outcome values. The article-reported 17 sites do not map one-to-one to seven submitted sample groups; do not promote sample, run, file or cell counts as developmental outcomes. Static review of the code release found cell-level annotations/batch labels but no link to the seven ENA sample groups or 17 implantation sites; the inspected cell-type comparison does not provide a per-sample/embryo replication term.

feasibility_boundary.supports: A source-linked, human early implantation-interface research platform with reported trophoblast and early conceptus/endometrial features through a day-14 endpoint.
does_not_establish: continuous support beyond early post-implantation development
limitations_reported_by_article: The model does not recreate the full complexity of endometrium.
The model lacks immune and vascular compartments.
The model is not straightforwardly adapted to high-throughput screening.
feasibility_boundary.model_use: Early human implantation/interface evidence only; not a complete artificial-womb machine specification or a transport-model calibration target.

code_release_static_review.figureS5G_test: Cell-level epithelial-versus-stromal FindMarkers comparison using MAST; no per-sample/embryo replicate term is shown in this inspected script.
code_release_static_review.cell_metadata_qc_field_anomaly: The nCount_RNA column is constant at SeuratProject for all 15,673 rows; do not interpret it as a count without validation.

supplement_screen.qualification: The inspected publisher-hosted MMC1 PDF provides a table of endometrial biopsies but no implantation-site IDs or crosswalk to the seven E-MTAB-13629 sample groups. The result is bounded to this PDF.
